title: Set an environment variable for the current session
summary: Create or change an environment variable that is available to commands you run in the current terminal window. This setting disappears when you close the terminal.

steps.explain: Run the export command with the variable name and value to make it available to child processes.

placeholders.name: VARIABLE
placeholders.description: The name of the environment variable

placeholders.name: VALUE
placeholders.description: The value to assign to the variable
